subject: BJ's Wholesale Club Fueling Station Litigation
overview: The Committee of the Whole met to receive an update on litigation regarding BJ's Wholesale Club's application for a flammable storage license. The council voted to enter executive session with legal counsel and announced a remanded public hearing for January 17.

items.title: BJ's Wholesale Club Flammable Storage License Litigation
items.summary: The council voted to enter executive session to discuss strategy with legal counsel regarding BJ's Wholesale Club's proposed fueling station at 278 Middlesex Avenue, noting a remanded public hearing is scheduled for January 17.
